settings.visualStyle: AI-generated historical reenactment styled as black-and-white 35mm Berlin April-May 1945 wartime field-newsreel footage. Shattered streets, brick dust, smoke, wrecked vehicles, dark building interiors, open city spaces, Soviet Red Army uniforms and period weapons. Moderate grain, gate weave, scratches, dust, flicker, soft optics and imperfect exposure. Non-graphic combat only. No modern objects, HDR, drone, gimbal, glossy lighting or triumphalist spectacle.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. A human wartime cameraman is physically embedded with the Soviet section through rubble streets and interiors. He climbs broken masonry, waits behind soldiers before exposed crossings, squeezes through doorways, crouches behind stone, reacts late to firing, loses exposure entering dark rooms and is repeatedly blocked by walls and bodies. No dialogue, narration, subtitles or music. Diegetic sound only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Human-operated late-war urban field-camera realism: brick dust on lens edge, crooked horizon while climbing rubble, exposure breathing between smoky daylight and dark interiors, focus hunting in dust, short unstable street runs, wall occlusion, cautious corner peeks and tired near-still holds.

cameraPresenceLock.cameraOperator: anonymous wartime correspondent physically present with Soviet urban infantry
bodyBehavior: leans from windows and corners cautiously

archivalLookLock.presentation: AI-generated reenactment with archival-style treatment; never claim genuine archive footage.
archivalLookLock.audioPolicy: No music, narration or intelligible dialogue. Diegetic sound only.

movie.plotDetails: A fictional Soviet infantryman anchors continuity while the cameraman shares the same rubble, rooms and street exposure.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a two-minute Berlin 1945 reenactment as if a human wartime correspondent were physically embedded with a Soviet infantry section. Camera must obey rubble, walls, doorways, smoke, cover and human reaction time. Follow shattered street, rubble climb, building entry, room-to-room tension, window observation, square crossing, brief street fire, another building, exhaustion, dust lull and final movement into smoke. Black-and-white 35mm newsreel treatment. No dialogue, narration or music. Non-graphic and period accurate, with no triumphalist propaganda.
movie.storySummary: A Soviet infantryman enters a ruined Berlin street, crosses rubble, moves through shelled interiors, reaches a broad exposed square, returns brief fire, continues through another building and ends walking into smoke. The human cameraman shares the same physical constraints and never gains an impossible overview.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP10 — Berlin 1945: The Last Streets

scenes.title: The Last Streets
scenes.description: A devastated Berlin street stretches ahead.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman advances past rubble and wrecked vehicle.
scenes.imageDescription: Berlin 1945, shattered street, Soviet infantry, smoke, brick dust, black-and-white 35mm grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman walks just behind the section, stepping over rubble; frame dips repeatedly to footing and is blocked by backs and wreckage. No clean center composition. Audio: boots on brick, artillery, wind, loose metal.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator reaches large rubble mound behind lead soldier.

scenes.title: Over the Rubble
scenes.description: Collapsed facade forces unit over masonry.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier climbs broken bricks and drops behind mound.
scenes.imageDescription: Large rubble mound, broken masonry, brick dust on uniforms.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator climbs after him using one hand for balance; horizon tilts, brick fills lower frame, camera bumps against debris and focus goes soft for a moment. Audio: bricks shifting, boots, breathing, distant battle.

scenes.title: Shelled Entrance
scenes.description: The section enters dark damaged building.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman moves from smoky daylight into dim corridor.
scenes.imageDescription: Blasted doorway, exposed brick, dark corridor, Soviet troops entering.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows directly behind; exposure remains too bright for a beat then darkens imperfectly, doorway edges scrape close to lens and another soldier blocks most of corridor. Audio: footsteps, grit, distant muffled gunfire.

scenes.title: Room to Room
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier leans through doorway, scans, shifts to next opening.
scenes.imageDescription: Dark ruined interior, broken doors, dust, no visible enemy required.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator remains one body behind, sees only partial room around soldier and door frame; one cautious lean, focus hunt in dimness, then small step forward. Audio: wood creak, debris, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera stops before next window room.

scenes.title: Window to the Street
scenes.description: A blasted window reveals smoke farther down road.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier scans from cover at broken sill.
scenes.imageDescription: Blown window, ruined street, smoke, soldier partly concealed.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman stays deeper in shadow behind soldier; frame includes wall and window edges, preventing a clean panoramic view. Exposure breathes between dark room and bright smoke outside. Audio: wind through opening, distant shots, artillery.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator backs from window with section.

scenes.title: Run to the Square
scenes.description: The section crosses exposed space toward cover.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier runs low to masonry fragment.
scenes.imageDescription: Open urban square approach, smoke, broken pavement, troops crossing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator waits behind doorway until soldiers move, then follows late in one short run. Heavy bounce, partial smoke blindness, abrupt drop behind masonry with camera hitting low. Audio: boots, gear, distant fire, debris.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera low behind same masonry cover.

scenes.title: Behind the Masonry
scenes.description: The men gather behind heavy broken stone.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier checks next route without exposing himself.
scenes.imageDescription: Broken stone cover, dusty square, compressed infantry, smoke beyond.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman kneels among them; bodies and stone block most view, one nervous reframe toward the gap ahead then immediate return. Audio: distant automatic fire, dust, breathing.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator stays behind stone for firing beat.

scenes.title: Street Fire
scenes.description: A brief exchange erupts from square edge.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier fires controlled shots toward distant frontage.
scenes.imageDescription: Urban firing position behind stone, distant opposing frontage, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator lifts only enough behind soldier’s shoulder to catch short firing sequence; masonry cuts lower frame and return fire makes him flinch down immediately. Audio: rifle shots, echoes, distant answering fire.

scenes.title: Another Building
scenes.description: The section moves into next damaged structure.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman follows through broken entrance.
scenes.imageDescription: Second ruined interior, deeper brick dust, dim hall.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows last, squeezed by doorway; frame rubs past plaster and soldiers, exposure again hunts from smoke-bright exterior to interior. Audio: boots, gear, battle muffled by walls.

scenes.title: Exhausted Corridor
scenes.description: The soldier pauses while others move ahead.
scenes.actionDescription: He lowers rifle and takes heavy breaths.
scenes.imageDescription: Dusty soldier against cracked wall, brick powder on shoulders, no active combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman stops too and braces against opposite wall; near-still view with tired hand tremor, dust drifting in and out of focus. No cinematic push-in. Audio: breathing, artillery through walls, falling plaster.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator turns toward doorway as unit exits.

scenes.title: Dust and Silence
scenes.description: The unit emerges into quieter street.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier steps slowly into road and surveys wreckage.
scenes.imageDescription: Quiet ruined street, dust in light, wrecked vehicle, rifle lowered.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator follows from dark doorway; exposure blows out briefly, then settles as he steps into dust. Frame drifts while he looks around, not a smooth reveal. Audio: wind, loose metal, distant battle.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera stays in street near lead soldier.

scenes.title: Smoke Over the City
scenes.description: Wider urban view shows smoke in several directions.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier pauses at square edge.
scenes.imageDescription: Wide damaged Berlin city space, smoke, infantry small foreground, no propaganda framing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman steps only onto low rubble beside soldier, gaining a modest human-height view; horizon remains slightly uneven and another wall cuts one side. No crane or rooftop shot. Audio: wind, distant artillery and engines.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator steps down and follows section onward.

scenes.title: Pockets of Resistance
scenes.description: The section enters one more dark structure.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier follows comrades into shadowed room.
scenes.imageDescription: Dark ruined room, smoke at doorway, exhausted late-war soldiers.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator follows last and loses subjects briefly in darkness; focus and exposure search while doorway behind blows out white. He remains close to wall for cover. Audio: boots, distant bursts, breath, debris.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera exits toward final street behind unit.

scenes.title: End of a Long War
scenes.description: The soldier returns to shattered street in fading light.
scenes.actionDescription: He walks slowly past broken masonry.
scenes.imageDescription: Long ruined Berlin street, smoke, exhausted infantry, no celebration.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman walks a few meters behind at tired pace; camera often drops to rubble footing then rises, breathing sway noticeable. No hero framing. Audio: boots, wind, distant artillery, gear.

scenes.title: Into the Smoke
scenes.description: The section disappears between ruins into smoke.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier becomes one small figure and vanishes ahead.
scenes.imageDescription: Long ruined street, receding infantry, smoke swallowing road, archival monochrome.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman stops from exhaustion behind a broken wall and holds at human shoulder height; wall edge remains in frame, smoke gradually hides the section. No pull-back, crane or victory image. Audio: diminishing boots, wind and distant battle only.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Final frame holds on smoke-filled empty street.

characters.name: Final Push Infantryman
characters.description: Anonymous Soviet Red Army infantryman in historically plausible late-war 1945 field gear, increasingly covered in brick dust.

continuity.continuityRules: Keep same face, helmet, rifle and uniform. Brick dust and grime accumulate and persist.

props.personalProps: rifle, steel helmet, field gear, ammunition pouches
